name: The Sunken Temple
summary: Angelas Moonbreeze points you toward a buried place and a missing scholar. Far below the earth, the Sunken Temple lies beyond any power Angelas has seen. To learn more, seek Marvon Rivetseeker, last known to be in Tanaris.

sections.title: A Place Banished Below
sections.body:
Angelas Moonbreeze tells you that the Sunken Temple was driven deep beneath the earth by forces beyond anything she has seen. She sends you to Marvon Rivetseeker, a goblin who studies ancient sites with her and Troyas.

Marvon left his home in Ratchet to investigate the troll ruins of Tanaris. No word of him has come for some time.

sections.title: What Marvon Says
sections.body: Marvon Rivetseeker says he has seen the Sunken Temple with his own eyes. He takes you for someone eager to travel and offers to share more, with knowledge he believes will intrigue you.

faq.q: Who starts the search for the Sunken Temple?
faq.answer: Angelas Moonbreeze points you toward the Sunken Temple, sunk deep beneath the earth by forces mightier than any she has seen.
Marvon Rivetseeker is a goblin who studies ancient sites across the world with Angelas and Troyas.
Marvon Rivetseeker left his home in Ratchet to investigate the troll ruins of Tanaris. No word of him has come for some time.
